entries.description: yi watsi tare da raina ‘yancin xan’adam
entries.subject: yi watsi

spans.text: Idan har aka yi watsi tare da raina ‘yancin xan’adam, hakan zai iya haifar da halayen ta’addanci waxanda za su mamaye tunanin al’umma.

entries.description: Xinkin Duniya tare da haxin gwiwar majalisar
entries.subject: Xinkin Duniya

spans.text: Haka nan qasashen da ke cikin Majalisar Xinkin Duniya tare da haxin gwiwar majalisar, sun xauki alqawarin bunqasa tare da samar da dukkan abubuwan da suka shafi kiyaye haqqoqin xan’adam.

entries.task_id: alqawarin bunqasa|tare|da samar da dukkan abubuwan da suka shafi kiyaye haqqoqin xan’adam
entries.description: alqawarin bunqasa tare da samar da dukkan abubuwan da suka shafi kiyaye haqqoqin xan’adam
entries.subject: alqawarin bunqasa
entries.object: da samar da dukkan abubuwan da suka shafi kiyaye haqqoqin xan’adam

spans.text: Haka nan qasashen da ke cikin Majalisar Xinkin Duniya tare da haxin gwiwar majalisar, sun xauki alqawarin bunqasa tare da samar da dukkan abubuwan da suka shafi kiyaye haqqoqin xan’adam.

entries.task_id: wannan quduri|tare|da sanya shi a ransa da kuma yin jihadi ta hanyar koyarwa da ilmantarwa domin a kiyaye waxannan haqqoqi da ‘yanci
entries.description: wannan quduri tare da sanya shi a ransa da kuma yin jihadi ta hanyar koyarwa da ilmantarwa domin a kiyaye waxannan haqqoqi da ‘yanci
entries.subject: wannan quduri
entries.object: da sanya shi a ransa da kuma yin jihadi ta hanyar koyarwa da ilmantarwa domin a kiyaye waxannan haqqoqi da ‘yanci

spans.text: Majalisar ta amince da cewa domin samar da cigaba ga dukkan al’umma, an buqaci kowanne mutum da ya kiyaye wannan quduri (dokokin ‘yanci) tare da sanya shi a ransa da kuma yin jihadi ta hanyar koyarwa da ilmantarwa domin a kiyaye waxannan haqqoqi da ‘yanci.

entries.description: ba tare da nuna wani bambanci ba
entries.subject: ba

spans.text: Kowa na da damar cin moriyar waxannan dokokin na‘yancin xan’adam, ba tare da nuna wani bambanci ba, kamar qabilanci da bambancin launin fata da na jinsi da na harshe da na addini da na siyasa ko kuma wani ra’ayi ko matsayi da ke da alaqa da qasar mutum ko wata qasar, mai ‘yanci ko marar ‘yanci, ko ma qarqashin kowanne irin mulki.

entries.task_id: da rayuwa|tare|da cikakken ‘yanci da samun tsaro na rayuka da dukiya
entries.description: da rayuwa tare da cikakken ‘yanci da samun tsaro na rayuka da dukiya
entries.subject: da rayuwa
entries.object: da cikakken ‘yanci da samun tsaro na rayuka da dukiya

spans.text: Kowanne mutum na da damar gudanar da rayuwa tare da cikakken ‘yanci da samun tsaro na rayuka da dukiya.

entries.description: xanqasa ba tare da qwaqqwaran dalili ba
entries.subject: xanqasa ba

spans.text: Babu wanda za a qwace wa ‘yancinsa na zama xanqasa ba tare da qwaqqwaran dalili ba, haka ba za a hana shi damar canza qasa ba, idan yana so.

entries.task_id: hayayyafa ba|tare|da la’akari da bambancin launin fata ko na qasa ko kuma na addini ba
entries.description: hayayyafa ba tare da la’akari da bambancin launin fata ko na qasa ko kuma na addini ba
entries.subject: hayayyafa ba
entries.object: da la’akari da bambancin launin fata ko na qasa ko kuma na addini ba

spans.text: Maza da mata da suka balaga suna da ‘yancin auren duk wanda suke so, kuma su hayayyafa ba tare da la’akari da bambancin launin fata ko na qasa ko kuma na addini ba.

entries.description: dukiya ba tare da hakki ba
entries.subject: dukiya ba

spans.text: Babu wanda za a qwace wa dukiya ba tare da hakki ba.

entries.task_id: yake so|tare|da bayar da gaskiya da shi
entries.description: yake so tare da bayar da gaskiya da shi
entries.subject: yake so
entries.object: da bayar da gaskiya da shi

spans.text: Kowanne mutum na da ‘yancin yin tunani a kan kansa, yana kuma da ‘yancin bin addinin da yake so tare da bayar da gaskiya da shi, shi kaxai ko cikin haxaka, a voye ko a bayyane.

entries.description: labarai ba tare da yin iyaka ba
entries.subject: labarai ba

spans.text: Kowanne mutum yana da ‘yancin bayyana ra’ayinsa; wannan ‘yanci kuwa ya hana a yi masa shisshigi kan wannan ra’ayi nasa, yana kuma da damar nema da karva da kuma fitar da duk wasu bayanai ta hanyar amfani da kafofin yaxa labarai ba tare da yin iyaka ba.
